- Success metrics: 30% latency reduction vs current baseline, embedding recall > 0.85 on the sample prompts, and infra cost < $0.12 per 1k tokens.
- Next steps:
  1) I'll send the SOW and our standard Master Service Agreement today for legal review (attached SOW).
  2) If procurement/legal want redlines, please route to Priya or your counsel -- we can review and iterate.
  3) Technical kickoff: propose Wed 3/3 10:00am PT (30m) to align on test data and endpoints.

I've attached the pilot SOW (Lumina_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf) and included Marissa (contracts) on the thread so she can help on the legal side. If your timeline shifted, let me know -- otherwise I'll pencil the 3/3 kickoff and follow up with a calendar invite.
